question: Where did the two-day Chintan Shivir, held on 7-8 March 2025 to discuss preparations for the 2028 and 2036 Olympics, take place?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hyderabad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The two-day **Chintan Shivir **was organized in **Hyderabad on 7-8 March 2025**.
 
• The event was held to discuss India’s preparations for hosting the 2028 and 2036 Olympics.
 
• Hyderabad, known for its modern infrastructure and technological advancements, was chosen as the venue for the brainstorming session.
 
• Senior officials, sports experts, and stakeholders participated in the event to strategize and plan for India’s Olympic ambitions.
 
• The Shivir focused on collaboration between government bodies, private sectors, and international organizations to bolster India's sports ecosystem.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Olympics Hosting Process:**

 
 
• The International Olympic Committee (IOC) selects host cities through a competitive bidding process.
 
• Countries submit detailed proposals showcasing infrastructure, budget, and legacy plans for hosting the Games.
 
• Emphasis is placed on sustainability, inclusivity, and long-term benefits for the host city.
 
 
 
• **India's Olympic Aspirations:**
 
 
• India has been working towards enhancing its sports infrastructure and training facilities.
 
• The government and private sectors are collaborating to boost athletes' performance on the global stage.
 
• Hosting the Olympics would showcase India’s organizational capabilities and promote sports culture nationwide.
 
 
 
• **Hyderabad as a Venue:**
 
 
• Hyderabad is one of India’s leading cities in terms of infrastructure and connectivity.
 
• It has hosted several international events, showcasing its ability to organize large-scale gatherings.
 
• The city’s advanced IT ecosystem and modern facilities make it an ideal location for strategic discussions.
 
 
 
• **India and the Olympics:**
 
 
• India first participated in the Olympics in **1900**.
 
• India has won medals in various disciplines, including hockey, wrestling, and athletics.
 
• Efforts are ongoing to improve India’s medal tally and overall performance in the Games.
